Sharing your sensor readings

Your home sensor measures temperature and humidity and sends the readings to Zava North Homes.

Housing and repairs staff with a work reason see the readings. They are not shared outside Zava North Homes by this service.

Share my home sensor readings with Zava North Homes staff

Staff cannot see your readings. New readings are not stored for your home.

Saying no, or stopping later, does not change your repairs, your tenancy or our safety duties. We will still repair your home and meet our legal safety checks.
